In fact, the sequence B_n(x) = x^n converges uniformly to f(x) = 0 on [0, 1) only if n goes to infinity. This is because the sequence B_n(x) = x^n converges uniformly to 0 on [0, 1) if and only if the sequence of suprema of B_n(x) converges to 0.

In general, if a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converges pointwise to a function f(x) on [0, 1], then the convergence is not necessarily uniform unless the sequence of polynomials is bounded or the function f(x) is continuous on [0, 1].
